note: Current (latest-generation) base stats for every Pokemon and alternate form (Mega, regional, Gmax, forme changes, etc.) listed on PokemonDB. Includes duplicate dexNum rows for alternate forms -- baseName is the plain species name, name is the full form-specific label (e.g. "Mega Venusaur", "Alolan Diglett", "Darmanitan (Zen Mode)"). Fields: dexNum, name, baseName, type1, type2 (null if monotype), total, hp, atk, def, spa, spd, spe.
